definitions.gloss: the four limbs; arms and legs
definitions.explanation: The two arms and two legs of a person, or the four legs of an animal. A written and medical word.

examples.japanese: {四肢|しし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伸|の}ばす→伸ばす：01973_nobasu⟧。
examples.english: I stretch out my arms and legs.
He was injured in all four limbs in the accident.

examples.japanese: ⟦カエル→カエル：28199_kaeru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦につれて→につれて：28400_nitsurete⟧{四肢|しし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|は}えて→生える：02392_haeru⟧くる。
examples.english: As frogs grow, they develop four limbs.

notes:
Formal; everyday speech says ⟦{手足|てあし}→手足：12799_teashi⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {四肢|しし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伸|の}ばす→伸ばす：01973_nobasu⟧: to stretch one's limbs
- {四肢|しし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧しびれ: numbness in the limbs (medical)
- {四肢|しし}{麻痺|まひ}: quadriplegia, paralysis of all four limbs

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{手足|てあし}→手足：12799_teashi⟧: hands and feet, limbs — the everyday word
- ⟦{胴体|どうたい}→胴体：13941_doutai⟧: torso, trunk
